steps: Clean BOM/CRLF text with CJK, emoji, tabs and a very long soft-wrapped row reports UTF-16 logical positions, including the active backward-selection end. Cancel preserves selection; invalid rows cannot navigate. Ctrl+G and far-row/EOF/first-row navigation are read-only and target the visible caret after BOM.

An independent full-text DOM Range geometry measurement verifies the far logical row is visible after long soft wrapping; navigation emits no input event, API request, dirty state or author file write.
Real typed input remains a native undoable operation after jumping to a distant line: Ctrl+Z removes only the typed edit and Ctrl+Y restores it.
Chinese, English and Japanese bar/dialog controls fit 390px. Switching language and opening/cancelling the dialog preserve source, selection and native undo/redo history.
Composition state, including a key event lacking isComposing and legacy keyCode 229, leaves source navigation inactive. Normal Tab moves focus without inserting text.

Only ordinary Save writes the typed source: exactly one document request, only target TXT changed, BOM/CRLF preserved, clean state restored. Navigation never writes source, registry, templates or assets.
New-script handoff and settings language changes restore source-navigation availability after modal close. Navigating the new script draft does not register or write it.
